channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: Under The Veil: A Night Of Burlesque & Variety Entertainment
item.description:
When: Tuesday, June 9, 2026 · 9pm

Where: The Veil Brewing-Scott's Addition, 1509B Belleville St, Richmond, VA 23230

Cost: $15

In-the-round burlesque and variety show by Burlesque Right Meow at Veil Brewing. Doors open at 8:30pm, show starts at 9pm; online sales closed at noon but tickets available at the door.

item.title: Nerdy Thirsty Thursdays
item.description:
When: Thursday, June 11, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10 adv / $14 dos

A bi-monthly nerd-culture cozyback featuring pop-up nerdlesque performances from across the DMV, Jackbox game competitions with prizes, video and board games, and trading card/anime merch. 18+ only.

item.title: Gemini Music Video Release Party
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 13, 2026 · 7pm – 12am

Where: DreamHaus, 110 N 18th St, Richmond, VA 23223

Cost: $20

A glittering cabaret night celebrating the premiere of Goldii's music video 'Gemini,' featuring burlesque by Empress de Naste, drag by Zorro Nova, live music from MADS, and an afterparty DJ set by The Disco Cat.

item.title: GAY ALL DAY! Burlesque & Variety Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 20, 2026 · 7pm – 10pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10-25

The 4th Annual Gay All Day Burlesque & Variety Show features a lineup of queer performers including Poppy la Fae, Gordita Maricona, Jo'Rie Tigerlily, and others, hosted by Zorro Nova with kitten Vulveeta and gogo D3ADP4NN. 18+ ticketed event on a sliding scale.

item.title: RÉVÉLER CABARET: RODEO EDITION
item.description:
When: Friday, June 26, 2026 · 8pm – 10:30pm

Where: Révéler, 3108 W Cary St, Richmond, VA 23221

Cost: $35

A Pride-themed Rodeo Edition cabaret featuring country vocalist Martha Spencer & The Wonderland Country Band, burlesque dancers, and emcee Qing Blaze — an evening of variety performance artistry in an intimate 107-seat Carytown venue. 21+ only.

item.title: Pours and Pasties Burlesque and Variety Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 27, 2026

Where: Strangeways Brewing - Scott's Addition, 3110 West Leigh Street, Richmond, VA 23230

Burlesque Right Meow's recurring Pours and Pasties series pairs craft beer with dazzling burlesque and variety acts at Strangeways Brewing in Scott's Addition.

item.title: Masquerade Ball Burlesque and Drag Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 27, 2026 · 8pm – 10pm

Where: Basic City RVA, 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224

A masquerade-themed burlesque and drag show at Basic City RVA's taproom. Features performers in a masked ball atmosphere.

item.title: Villain Era: A Burlesque Tribute to Bad Witches and Bitches
item.description:
When: Friday, July 3, 2026 · 8pm

Where: Firehouse Theatre, 1609 West Broad Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Burlesque Right Meow's Villain Era is a themed burlesque tribute celebrating bad witches and bitches with stunning acts and variety performances at Richmond's Firehouse Theatre.

item.title: RVA Burlesque Bingo 7/10
item.description:
When: Friday, July 10, 2026

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Rd, Richmond, VA

Cost: $21.00

Performance-based burlesque bingo at Blue Bee Cider where your card is filled with moments from live acts — mark what you see, shout TATAS!, and win prizes. 21+ event.

Where: Basic City RVA, 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224

A burlesque show by Burlesque Right Meow (the Reveal Revue troupe) at Basic City RVA's craft beer and pizza taproom.
